title: Superannuation Legislation Amendment (Fair Super for Young Workers) Bill 2026
short_title: Superannuation Legislation Amendment (Fair Super for Young Workers) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
summary.describes_version: as explained in the linked explanatory memorandum
sentences: This bill would remove the age-based exemption that currently keeps many employees under eighteen outside compulsory employer superannuation.
Young employees would no longer have to work more than thirty hours in a week to overcome that exemption.
The changes would commence on the day after Royal Assent.
changes: Removes the power to exclude under-eighteen employees, their work or their earnings through the relevant regulations.
Repeals the regulation exempting under-eighteen employees who work thirty hours or less a week.
Applies the change from the day after assent rather than introducing a staged commencement.
summary.affected: Employees under eighteen and employers responsible for their superannuation contributions are affected.
